summary: Verified fix for 'refused to connect' bug after uploading PDF/exporting on web. End-to-end mobile-web flow (390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL https://field-evidence-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com): Employee demo-chip login -> dashboard -> new-project-button -> pdf-import-button -> file chooser set to /app/tests/sample_inspection_report.pdf -> status transitioned to 'Filled from sample_inspection_report.pdf' -> changed new-project-ref to unique TEST-DL-<ts> -> new-project-submit -> project detail /project/<id>. Tapping open-report-button fired a page.expect_download event with suggested filename 'inspection-report.pdf' (file bytes start with %PDF-), page.url remained on /project/<id>, no 'refused to connect' text appeared, and the toast 'Inspection PDF downloaded' was shown. Tapping export-project-button fired a download named 'project-evidence.zip' and the URL was unchanged. Logged out, logged back in with demo-admin-button, navigated to Account tab, tapped menu-export-all: download fired with 'remedialflow-metadata.json' and the URL stayed on /account. All four assertions from the review request pass; the window.open regression is resolved by src/projects.ts openSigned() using an in-page <a download> blob link on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Harmless but should be migrated. Likely emitted from a shared RN component (e.g. an overlay/Pressable). Ref: run console logs.

action_items: Optional: migrate any `pointerEvents=` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the RN web deprecation warning.
Optional: suppress or clear in-form toast after download in case tests re-check body text later (not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: src/projects.ts openSigned() correctly guards Platform.OS !== 'web' and uses a same-origin blob + <a download> trick to avoid iframe/preview popup blocking. The URL.revokeObjectURL is deferred 60s which is safe.
If the signed URL ever returns 4xx (e.g. expired), the thrown 'Download failed (status)' is surfaced via toast in both open-report and export call sites — good.
Consider adding `a.style.display = 'none'` before appending (purely cosmetic to avoid layout flashes on slow browsers).
seed_data_creation: Created one additional project with ref TEST-DL-<timestamp> via the PDF-import flow during the test. Left in DB (status=active).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run the download regression: mobile viewport 390x844, demo-employee-button -> login-submit-button -> new-project-button -> pdf-import-button + page.expect_file_chooser + set_files('/app/tests/sample_inspection_report.pdf'), wait for 'Filled from' text, set unique ref, submit, then page.expect_download() around clicks on open-report-button / export-project-button / menu-export-all. Validate page.url is unchanged after each download and body text does not contain 'refused to connect'.
rca_of_issue: Previous bug: on web, openReport/openExport awaited an async /api/.../report-link call then called window.open(signedUrl). Browsers (and the Emergent preview iframe in particular) block popups opened outside of a direct user-gesture tick, so the preview rendered 'refused to connect' or blanked. Fix in src/projects.ts: on web, fetch the signed URL to a Blob, URL.createObjectURL(blob), create an <a download> element on document.body, click() and remove it. Download now happens in-place with no popup and no iframe navigation. Native path still uses Linking.openURL. Verified working for inspection-report.pdf, project-evidence.zip, and remedialflow-metadata.json.
